{{Quote|Rackfever is epidemic on the planet. Anyone who visits runs a high risk of infection. There is no known cure for the disease. Any volunteers?''"<br />"''I'll go, Admiral.|An Admiral and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="RPG" />}}
'''Control Disease''' was a [[Force power/Legends#Control|Control]]-based [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] which allowed a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force user]] to direct their own body's antibodies to combat a [[Disease/Legends|disease]]. In the case of a long-standing or particularly virulent disease, the Force user would sometimes take [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] or [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of intensive control to throw it off. Ailments like the [[Cold/Legends|cold]] or [[Flu/Legends|flu]] could be cured relatively quickly, while more serious diseases such as [[Gangrene/Legends|gangrene]], [[tuberculosis]] and [[Lung/Legends|lung]] [[cancer]] took longer to treat.<ref name="RPG" /> If successful, the individual could also prevent themselves from being infectious, even if the disease was not completely cured.<ref name="RC">''[[The Star Wars Rules Companion]]''</ref> The power could also be extended to affect other individuals; the process was made easier by the relationship between the two individuals, and the proximity between them.<ref name="RPG" />

Sometime during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[rackfever]] epidemic hit a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] volunteered to visit the planet despite there being no known cure for the disease, knowing that he would be able to use the Force power to prevent himself from succumbing to the illness.<ref name="RPG" />
